objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-indirect-command-execution-via-series-of-forfiles
objects.description: The following analytic detects excessive usage of the forfiles.exe process, which is often indicative of post-exploitation activities. The detection leverages data from Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) agents, focusing on process execution logs that include process GUID, process name, and parent process.
